_comment: What this repo's security references were last checked against. The monthly 'Standards watch' workflow fails (and GitHub emails the failure) when upstream has moved past this. After re-checking the README/Dockerfile citations, update the values below in a PR. For OWASP the failure message includes a compare link and this cheat sheet's own diff since the reviewed commit.

cis_docker_benchmark.note: Control numbers cited in README.md, Dockerfile and RUNTIME_SECURITY.md were checked against the CIS Docker Benchmark v1.9.0 PDF (dated 2026-09-30). The numbering changes between versions - re-check every cited number when bumping.
